2607.16414.title: Signal-based Model Access Risk Analysis for AI System Operations Security
2607.16414.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are now ubiquitous across domains such as security, finance, healthcare, consumer technology, and large-scale cloud services, where they process massive volumes of data and make consequential decisions daily. This widespread adoption has created a broad attack surface through which adversaries can manipulate, evade, extract information from, or otherwise subvert deployed models. Depending on system design and exposure, attackers may have very different forms of access: some observe only final decisions, while others receive confidence scores, intermediate representations, or even full model parameters. While previous surveys typically organize evasion attacks into white-box, gray-box, and black-box categories based on the attacker's knowledge of model internals (architecture, parameters, gradients), this taxonomy often conflates different deployment scenarios that provide vastly different output signals, all labeled as ``black-box'' despite enabling fundamentally different attack strategies. Understanding how evasion attack strategies adapt to the specific information signals returned by deployed systems is critical for organizations making procurement and deployment decisions. To address this gap, we introduce the Signal-based Model Access Risk Taxonomy (SMART), a deployment-oriented framework that classifies attacker access according to the nature and richness of the information signals available from deployed AI systems. Using this taxonomy, we provide a structured overview of evasion attacks across progressively richer levels of information exposure, highlighting how deployment interfaces influence attack capabilities and informing more secure AI deployment and procurement decisions.
2607.16414.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）系統現在在安全、金融、醫療保健、消費科技和大規模雲服務等領域無處不在，這些系統每天處理大量數據並做出重要決策。這種廣泛的採用創造了一個廣泛的攻擊面，敵手可以通過這個面來操控、逃避、提取信息或以其他方式顛覆已部署的模型。根據系統設計和暴露程度，攻擊者可能擁有非常不同的訪問形式：有些僅觀察最終決策，而其他人則接收置信度分數、中間表示，甚至完整的模型參數。雖然之前的調查通常根據攻擊者對模型內部（架構、參數、梯度）的知識將逃避攻擊組織為白盒、灰盒和黑盒類別，但這種分類往往混淆了提供截然不同輸出信號的不同部署場景，所有這些都被標記為「黑盒」，儘管它們啟用的攻擊策略根本上是不同的。了解逃避攻擊策略如何適應已部署系統返回的特定信息信號，對於做出採購和部署決策的組織至關重要。為了解決這一空白，我們引入了基於信號的模型訪問風險分類法（SMART），這是一個以部署為導向的框架，根據已部署AI系統提供的信息信號的性質和豐富程度對攻擊者的訪問進行分類。利用這一分類法，我們提供了對逃避攻擊的結構化概述，涵蓋了逐漸豐富的信息暴露水平，強調了部署接口如何影響攻擊能力，並為更安全的AI部署和採購決策提供信息。
